description: The line plot illustrates the comparison of initial and final accuracy in relation to the o-pop frequency, measured in units of 10^4. The x-axis is labeled "o_pop frequency (x10^4)" and is linear, with tick labels at intervals of 2, ranging from 1 to 19. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and is linear, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0. The plot features two lines: the green line represents the initial accuracy, and the blue line represents the final accuracy. The green line starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.4 at an o-pop frequency of 1, peaks at around 0.8 at an o-pop frequency of 5, and ends at an accuracy of about 0.4 at an o-pop frequency of 19. The blue line starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.8 at an o-pop frequency of 1, peaks at around 1.0 at an o-pop frequency of 3, and ends at an accuracy of about 0.8 at an o-pop frequency of 19. Both lines show variability indicated by error bars, with the green line having a smaller range of error compared to the blue line.
